seg: And I think to myself, what a wonderful world.
The colours of the rainbow, so pretty in the sky.
And I saw all their faces, of people going by, and I saw his face shake in fear, saying, how do you do? They're really saying, I don't know.
At his face was blood, and bones had grown. Then there was hope, then I'll never know. Then I think to myself, what a wonderful world.
Yes, I've been to myself, but I'm more than full grown.
